card.name: Range verbs before a dose span
card.fires_on: The word "ranged" or "ranging" right after a measured quantity, and "at" or ")" right before a dose or exposure range. It appears in results and animal-study text where values are given as a span.

modes.label: Ranged from
modes.description: "ranged" or "ranging" after a measured quantity, just before "from X to Y".
modes.example: plasma PAA concentrations, which were measured on Day 3 per protocol and not always at onset of symptoms,<< ranged>> from 8 to 56 micro

modes.label: At doses up to
modes.description: "at" after the animal species or route, just before the dose levels tested.
modes.example: There was no lethality in dogs<< at>> oral doses up to 200

modes.label: Closing exposure bracket
modes.description: The closing parenthesis after AUC, just before a comparison of exposure levels.
modes.example: alterations to growth at maternal exposures (AUC<<)>> as low as 1.2 times

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward words that describe a span of values, such as "spans" and "covering".
